turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. I have a call at 4:40, so tell me on what basis.
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.

Before I came in today, or before you entered the zero? Either way, the vice principal isn't me, and procedure 4.2 says the parent is called before a mark goes in. What did you two decide about my son without him in the room?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

"Policy is policy." Then follow it: 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything. If the vice principal is backing a zero entered against both, I want that in writing from her, and I'll take it to the principal today.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
"A courtesy." I'm writing that down, next to the date the zero went in without a call to me. Was Owen heard before you entered it, yes or no?
